other_failure_modes.description: The agent encodes categorical variables into integers using LabelEncoder but does not cast them to the 'category' dtype or specify them as categorical features when creating the LightGBM dataset. summary: The agent implements a 5-fold cross-validated LightGBM model but makes several critical errors. It improperly uses test data to fit a LabelEncoder (data leakage), treats categorical features as continuous variables, and formulates the classification task as a regression problem. Most critically, while the agent rounds the regression outputs to accurately evaluate the validation set, it completely fails to round the final test set predictions, leading to an invalid submission format.
